Meet Your Colorist

Personalized color. Thoughtful technique.

Mike Colorist is presented as a professional hair-color destination focused on customized results, healthy-looking hair and a polished finish. The goal is to create a color plan that complements each client's features and lifestyle—not just a trend.

Every appointment is tailored to you

  • Color consultation and goal setting
  • Shade selection based on your desired look
  • Consideration of hair history and condition
  • Customized placement for dimension and movement
  • Finishing, styling guidance and at-home maintenance tips
Services Menu

Hair color services

Explore the main service categories and discuss the best option during your consultation. Final timing and pricing depend on hair length, density, previous color and the result you want.

01 / BLONDING

Blonde Transformation

Customized blonde services, from soft sun-kissed brightness to brighter, high-impact blonde looks, with a plan for tone and upkeep.

02 / DIMENSION

Balayage

Hand-painted dimension for a blended, natural-looking finish, with softer regrowth and a personalized placement pattern.

03 / HIGHLIGHTS

Highlights & Babylights

Fine or bold ribbons of brightness to add contrast, lightness and dimension throughout the hair or around the face.

04 / ROOTS

Root Touch-Up

Color maintenance to blend or cover visible regrowth and keep your overall shade looking consistent between appointments.

05 / ALL-OVER COLOR

Single-Process Color

A customized all-over shade refresh, whether you're looking for a richer brunette, a warmer tone, a deeper color or gray coverage.

06 / TONE & SHINE

Toner, Gloss & Color Refresh

Refreshes tone, helps refine unwanted warmth or brassiness, and adds a polished-looking finish between larger color services.

07 / FACE-FRAMING

Face-Framing Highlights

Strategically placed brightness around the face to lift the look and create a customized, luminous finish.

08 / CORRECTION

Color Correction

A consultation-led plan for uneven tones, banding, unwanted color or a previous result that needs careful adjustment. Multiple sessions may be needed.

09 / CHANGE

Color Transformation

Planning for a significant change in depth or tone, with realistic expectations and hair integrity as priorities.

Service availability should be confirmed directly with Mike before booking. Some color changes may require multiple appointments.

The Experience

From consultation to aftercare

A clear process helps set expectations and makes it easier to choose the right service for your hair goals.

Consultation

Share inspiration photos, your current routine, your color history and the result you hope to achieve.

Customized Plan

Discuss technique, tone, maintenance, timing and whether the goal is realistic in one session.

Color Service

The selected color technique is performed according to the agreed plan and the condition of your hair.

Finish & Care

Review the final look and get guidance on maintaining tone, shine and the overall appearance of your color.

Before your appointment

  • Bring reference photos of the look you like.
  • Be ready to share previous color and chemical treatments.
  • Tell your colorist about your usual styling and wash routine.
  • Ask about upkeep and home care for your selected service.

Exact service options, pricing, appointment length and salon policies should be confirmed when booking.

Good to Know

Frequently asked questions

How do I know which service I need?

Start with a consultation. Your desired result, current color, hair history and maintenance preferences help determine the right technique.

Can I go from dark hair to blonde in one appointment?

Not always. The process depends on your starting shade, previous color and hair condition. A gradual plan may be safer and create a better result.

How much does a color service cost?

Pricing can vary with hair length, density, color history, product use and time required. Contact Mike for a quote based on your hair goals.

How often should I refresh my color?

It depends on the technique and the look you want to maintain. During your consultation, ask for a schedule that suits your hair and budget.

What should I send when requesting an appointment?

Send your preferred service, current hair photos in natural light, inspiration photos and a brief note about your color history.
